in_sanskrit.name: Jashan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Feast, Festival
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jashan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Jashan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jash', which means 'to feast'. This name is associated with joy, happiness, and celebration. It is often given to a boy born during a festive occasion or to one who is expected to bring joy and happiness to his family.
